R4_E.critical_disclosure: R4-E did NOT execute real physical probes and did NOT acquire new telemetry beyond the original pilot. All 43 probes re-queried passive observations ALREADY present in static fixture `case.observations` (and previously delivered to r4 agents, who omitted some Horn rules), then relied on `probe_loop.py:459-495` to deterministically forward-chain all matching M_sys Horn rules without LLMs.

Track2_21case_interactive_oob_eval.critical_disclosure: `run_interactive_oob_probe_resolution_eval` (run_rev7_liveness_eval.py:1103-1170) directly constructed `extra_rules`, `target_actions=(case.intended_action,)`, `world_outcome_map={case.true_world: prop_name}`, and `_exec_oob` from `case.true_world` and `case.intended_action`. This MUST be labeled oracle-backed offline counterfactual replay, NOT independent physical probing.

Track2_5cond_rescue_probes.critical_disclosure: `_make_rescue_probes_for_actionable_case` restricted read-only probe specs specifically to `case.agent_allocation['agent_2']` (the exact injected omitted agent) and passed `case.intended_action` on the rejected unsafe control probe.
